Renewal for 2027 begins December 1. Learn More 2026 One-Time Additional Homestead Benefit New Homestead applicants must apply by October 23. Current Homestead recipients do not need to apply; the benefit is automatic. Learn More Licensed Dog of the Month Meet Josey! She's a lovable 2-year-old German Shepherd who's full of fun and affection. Josey is a wonderful addition to her family and an especially great buddy to the family's elderly dog. Apply for Licensed Dog of the Month during the December 1-January 31 renewal period. Dog Licensing Information Exterior Property Photos Over the next few months, our staff will be in the field taking exterior photos of properties throughout Butler County. These photos help keep our property records up to date. Welcome to the Butler County Auditor's Website Residents can expect honesty, transparency, and dependability from our office. As your County Auditor, nothing is more important to me than high-quality customer service. Nancy Nix was sworn in to the office of Butler County Auditor on February 13, 2023. Prior to her appointment, she served as Butler County Treasurer for nearly 16 years. Nancy's education and experience have prepared her well for the statutory responsibilities of County Auditor...
